newsitem.title: UK: Comfy Interactive Movies to seek Tel-Aviv listing.
newsitem.headline: Comfy Interactive Movies to seek Tel-Aviv listing.

text.p: Israel's Comfy Interactive Movies said on Thursday it plans to seek a full listing on the Tel-Aviv Stock Exchange by the end of May.
Comfy, which manufactures computer hardware and software mainly for children, said it expects to raise between $25 million and $30.0 million with the issue.
The shares will be listed in Tel-Aviv and will be quoted on SEAQ International in London.
The company, which has formed alliances with MGM Interactive and JVC of Japan, sells its products in 14 languages including Japanese.
In Israel the issue will be underwritten by IBI and Leader, while in London the SEAQ quote will be arranged by SocGen.
Chief executive Itai Kohavia said Comfy would be the first hi-tech company to list in Israel.
"We will be the first start-up hi-tech comany to gain a domestic quote," said Kohavia. "The market is right and the timing is right."
